sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit, before any margin (cost:350020).
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We accept your proposal to extend the contract term to 24 months, which enables us to reduce the price to EUR 429.22 per unit. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. Which volume can you commit to? Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown shortly.

Our updated Angebot comprises a price of €429.22 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have reviewed the delivery and historical price data you provided; while we acknowledge these figures, our current pricing reflects updated operational realities. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

As to the delivery record and price history data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. As our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027, the unit price must remain at EUR 429.22.

Our current offer stands at a price of €429.22 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

To support your long-term planning, we are pleased to accept your proposal for a 36-month contract term at this price. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €429.22 per unit, a price of €429.22 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
